verdict.rationale: Autumn's docs explicitly cover defining plans (autumn.config.ts + atmn CLI), attaching plans to customers with automatic handling of new subscriptions, upgrades, and downgrades, usage-based/pay-per-use pricing with proration-like billing period logic, and webhooks firing on plan changes (new subscriptions, upgrades, downgrades). Community feedback corroborates real-world use for billing/entitlements and notes Autumn's team handling of annual/monthly billing transitions and race conditions. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of free trials and detailed proration mechanics, plus independent hands-on verification of trial/upgrade billing flows.
